name: outcast
description: Casts whatever the player plays out to any uplink: Icecast, SHOUTcast, RTMP, SRT, HLS, the LAN or a file. An evo framework plugin built on evotap.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Streams whatever the player plays, from any service, to Icecast, SHOUTcast, RTMP, SRT, HLS, the LAN or a file, with the screen's title. Built on evotap.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.28 First store release. Streams whatever the player plays, from any service, to Icecast or SHOUTcast, RTMP, SRT, HLS and DASH, a stream on the LAN or a recording to file, with the screen's title; each uplink has its own encoder, transport and reconnection, up to three Icecast destinations at once; DJ mode schedules the day's programme. Built on evotap and evopeg.
